title: WISE: An Agentic Framework for Whole-page Multimodal Search Experience Attribution
abstract: arXiv:2611.06777v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Algorithm-driven services, including search, recommendation, and advertising, rely on multi-stage model pipelines. While research prioritizes model optimization, post-deployment monitoring focuses on operational reliability. Yet operationally healthy systems may still produce poor-quality results, exposing a gap in existing evaluation and monitoring practices. However, a systematic problem formulation and benchmark for this task remain lacking. To bridge this gap, we formulate System Quality Diagnosis (SQD) for algorithm-driven services, a new task that extends quality evaluation beyond identifying poor outcomes to attributing their causes across system components. Focusing on industrial search, we propose WISE, an agentic framework for end-to-end quality diagnosis that discovers user-facing issues and traces their origins to underlying algorithmic components. To improve diagnostic reliability, we introduce ReTrace for constructing evide

translated_title: WISE：面向整页多模态搜索体验归因的智能体框架
translated_abstract: 算法驱动的服务，包括搜索、推荐和广告，依赖于多阶段模型流水线。虽然研究界优先关注模型优化，而部署后的监控则聚焦于运营可靠性，但运营上健康的系统仍可能产生低质量的结果，这暴露了现有评估与监控实践的空白。然而，针对这一任务的系统性问题定义和基准仍然缺失。为了弥补这一空白，我们为算法驱动的服务提出了系统质量诊断（SQD）这一新任务，它将质量评估从仅仅识别低质量结果扩展到在系统各组件中归因其成因。聚焦于工业搜索场景，我们提出了WISE——一个用于端到端质量诊断的智能体框架，它能够发现面向用户的问题，并将其根源追溯到底层的算法组件。为了提高诊断的可靠性，我们引入了ReTrace用于构建证据（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了系统质量诊断（SQD）这一新任务，并构建了WISE智能体框架，能够对工业搜索服务进行端到端的质量诊断，发现面向用户的问题并将其归因到底层算法组件。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the System Quality Diagnosis (SQD) task and WISE, an agentic framework for end-to-end quality diagnosis of industrial search services, discovering user-facing issues and tracing their origins to underlying algorithmic components.
